aliases.name: TRUMP INTERNATIONAL GOLF LINKS - SCOTLAND
aliases.notes: Item 069 of Part 2 Exhibit A. Form descriptor: 'Underlying Assets: golf course; Location: Aberdeen, Scotland'.

notes: Trump-branded golf course at Menie Estate near Aberdeen, Scotland. Foreign-operating entity (per Fork G §3 amendment §2.7 anomaly #3 ruling: foreign operating entities default-include the same way domestic operating entities do; no separate bucket treatment). Held via The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust (cp_entity_0003). Distinct from cp_entity_0006 Trump International Golf Links - Doonbeg (Ireland). Registered in Fork G as one of the original 5 Over-$50M named entities; ownership edge cp_rel_0356.
